summary.zh: 搭 CI/CD、容器与云上部署流程
summary.en: CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, containers and cloud deploys

description.zh: 搭建构建与发布链路：CI/CD 流水线、Terraform 基础设施即代码、Dockerfile、容器编排，以及部署到 AWS、GCP 或 Azure。适合新项目要上线、发布靠手工或需要统一云上环境时使用。
description.en: Sets up build and release paths: CI/CD pipelines, Terraform infrastructure as code, Dockerfiles, containers and deploys to AWS, GCP or Azure. Fits a new project going live or a release still run by hand.
